name: keyart
request: A sleek pearl-white futuristic hover-racer with three blazing orange-white rear thrusters and long glowing exhaust trails, screaming low over an endless orange desert at hypersonic speed, kicking up a rooster tail of sand, a visible vapour cone around it. Towering red sandstone mesas on the horizon, huge clear deep-blue sky, hard bright sun. Dark enemy drones with red glows explode in fireballs behind it. Strong motion blur at the edges, the craft sharp in the centre. Low chase-camera angle from behind.
